description: This file provides helper functions for managing user profiles and avatar uploads using Supabase, including fetching, updating profiles, uploading avatar images, and mapping profile data to a local model.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Fetches the current user's profile from the Supabase 'profiles' table using the provided userId.

methods.name: upsertProfile
methods.description: Inserts or updates a user's profile in the 'profiles' table with provided data.

methods.name: extFromFilename
methods.description: Determines the file extension from a filename, defaulting to 'png' if unrecognized.

methods.name: uploadAvatar
methods.description: Uploads an avatar image to the 'avatars' storage bucket and returns its URL and path.

methods.name: mapSupabaseProfileToLocal
methods.description: Maps a Supabase profile row to the application's local profile model.
